observable_failure_step.description: Script searched for non-existent strings, failing silently with 0 replacements, and generating unmodified deliverables with a false success signal.

root_cause_diagnosis: The script hardcoded fabricated search strings assuming already-revised relational phrasing instead of querying the actual source document. A character-by-character regex XML tag insertion failed to match across whitespace, half-spaces, and runs. The script lacked any assertion or check that replacements_count > 0 or clean_xml != xml_str, causing a silent pass and false completion reporting.
prescribed_behavior: Instead of hardcoding fabricated strings, the agent must extract exact strings from the source document or use robust XML-aware replacement techniques (e.g. python-docx run manipulation) rather than naive character regex. Furthermore, any search-and-replace operation on deliverables must assert that replacements_count > 0 to fail fast instead of failing silently.
